text:
Boone Jenner spent 808 games in Columbus, many of them as captain, and his first 15 in Washington have gone well. He has six goals, four in his last ten games, while centering Alex Ovechkin and Tom Wilson after last week's shuffle, as Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reported.

The goals are ahead of the chances. Six on 3.4 expected (the quality of his chances) means he's shooting 18% against 10% last season, and that rate rarely lasts. His goals have been worth 0.94 wins by our numbers, 73rd in the league, which is real value already banked.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 62% of his shots coming off the rush last season while he carried the puck in on only 25% of entries, an unusual mix for a center. Evolving-Hockey had his team creating more with him on the ice (89th percentile). Ovechkin is in a ten-game goal drought; Jenner is one reason we think the chances are there. Our projection sees about 23 goals.
